about: Usability acceptance set: questions a real user asks about the five Gutenberg books in the Shared library. Each item states the behaviour the user should get. expect: answer | library | not_in_sources | smalltalk. cite: at least one citation must come from a document whose name contains one of these. mention: the answer must contain at least one of these (case-insensitive). Multi-turn items send turns in order in one chat; checks apply to the last turn.
